title: Appeal Rights Schedule for the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Payer Classes
content:
The appeal rights Riverbend can use on a Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) depend on its payer class. The windows are counted as the appeal-window rule of the claim policy describes (from the denial notice date, with any presumed-receipt days added first).

| Payer class | Provider-level appeal window (days) | Member-level appeal window (days) | Presumed-receipt days added to the notice date | Appeal levels available | Payer decides a post-service appeal within (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 180 | 180 | 0 | 2 | 60 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 90 | 180 | 0 | 2 | 60 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 180 | 180 | 0 | 2 | 60 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 60 | 65 | 0 | 5 | 60 |
| Original Medicare Claim | 120 | 120 | 5 | 5 | 60 |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 60 | 60 | 0 | 2 | 30 |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 90 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 60 |

A member-level window of 0 means the program has no member-level appeal; for a Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim, disputes go to the state workers' compensation process.

**Independent external review and submission**

| Payer class | External review available | External-review window (calendar months after the final internal adverse determination) | Appeal submission channel |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | yes | 4 | payer portal |
| Commercial HMO Claim | yes | 4 | payer portal |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | yes | 4 | payer portal |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | no | 0 (not available) | payer portal |
| Original Medicare Claim | no | 0 (not available) | Medicare Administrative Contractor portal |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | no | 0 (not available) | ForwardHealth portal |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | no | 0 (not available) | mailed packet |

**Common to every payer class**
- An expedited (urgent) appeal is decided within 72 hours.
- The appeal packet includes the encounter's medical records.

Example (hypothetical): on a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim with both internal levels used, external review remains possible for 4 months; on a Medicare Advantage Plan Claim it is not available at all.
